title: ChainAgent: Automated Chainable Vulnerability Discovery in PHP Web Applications
abstract: arXiv:2611.25412v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: High-impact attacks on PHP web applications often chain limited-capability vulnerabilities with other flaws or intended behaviors. Discovering these chains requires identifying flaws and the dependencies enabling capability composition. Existing vulnerability discovery techniques analyze flaws in isolation, while attack planning assumes known components. This separation makes it difficult to discover previously unknown components whose security relevance becomes apparent only through their potential roles in an exploit chain.   We present ChainAgent, a goal-directed LLM-agent framework that jointly discovers exploit-chain components and their capability dependencies in source code. Guided by an empirical study of 386 real-world web exploit chains, ChainAgent represents vulnerabilities and functional gadgets--intended program behaviors that can be repurposed in attacks--through preconditions and capabilities over security-relevant objec

translated_title: ChainAgent：PHP Web应用中可链式利用漏洞的自动化发现
translated_abstract: 针对PHP Web应用程序的高影响攻击通常会将能力有限的漏洞与其他缺陷或预期行为链接起来形成攻击链。发现这些攻击链需要识别漏洞本身以及支持能力组合的依赖关系。现有的漏洞发现技术只是孤立地分析漏洞，而攻击规划方法则假设攻击组件是已知的。这种割裂使得发现那些安全相关性只有通过其在攻击链中的潜在作用才能显现出来的未知组件变得十分困难。我们提出了ChainAgent，这是一个目标导向的LLM智能体框架，能够在源代码中联合发现攻击链组件及其能力依赖关系。在对386个真实Web攻击链的实证研究指导下，ChainAgent通过前置条件以及安全相关对象上的能力来表示漏洞和功能性gadget（即可以在攻击中被重新利用的预期程序行为）……
tldr: ChainAgent是一个目标导向的LLM智能体框架，基于对386个真实Web攻击链的实证研究，能够在PHP Web应用源代码中自动联合发现漏洞与功能gadget等攻击链组件及其能力依赖关系，突破了传统漏洞分析孤立检测、攻击规划依赖已知组件的局限。
